answer_1.quote: Our focus is on Vision-Language Natural Language Explanation (VL-NLE) tasks which demand generating an answer and a high-quality explanation given an image-question pair.
answer_1.outputs: natural language explanations for visual reasoning questions

answer_2.quote: In keeping with established practices, we employ N-gram scores, including BLEU, METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), ROUGE, CIDEr, SPICE, and BERTScore. We also use a more recent metric, G-Eval, which uses GPT4 and Auto-Chain-Of-Thought for evaluation that has been shown to align better with human evaluations.
